questions.question_bn: Motor constant mechanical power 30 W। speed 3 m/s-এ force কত N?

questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 12। Active prediction Ic=βIb=0.5×(12) mA। Load সীমা Ic=(12−0.2)/1000=11.8mA। prediction এই সীমা ছাড়ালে transistor saturated; ছোট মানটি নিতে হবে।

questions.question_bn: Rest থেকে constant acceleration 4 m/s²। 9-তম second-এ distance কত m?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। s((9))−s((9)−1)=2×(9)²−2((9)−1)²=4×(9)−2। মোট distance আর nth-second distance আলাদা।

questions.question_bn: Spring oscillator mass m period T। mass 49m করলে new period কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 7। T=2π√(m/k); mass factor (7)² gives period factor (7)। amplitude period-এ আসে না।

questions.question_bn: Cycle-এ heat absorbed 35 J, rejected 21 J। net work by gas কত J?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 7। Cycle শেষে internal energy change zero। net work=net heat=Qin−Qout=2×(7) J।

questions.question_bn: Laminar flow tube length L→7L, radius r→2r, same viscosity। hydraulic resistance ratio new/old কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 7। Poiseuille R∝L/r⁴। ratio=(7)/(2⁴)=(7)/16; radius squared নয় fourth power।

questions.question_bn: Cu²⁺electrolysistheoreticalmass 55g,actual 44g। current efficiency কত %?

questions.question_bn: Food oil iodometry-তে I₂ 27mmol মুক্ত। I₂+2S₂O₃²⁻→2I⁻+S₄O₆²⁻। thiosulfate কত mmol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 27। Reaction coefficients iodine 1 ও thiosulfate 2। তাই nmmol iodine fully titrate করতে 2nmmol thiosulfate।

questions.question_bn: Acid ও alcohol 1:1 ester if i cation, limiting acid 20 mol, isolated yield 75%। ester mole কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 20। Theoretical ester amount limiting acid (20) mol। actual 75%=0.75×(20)=3×(20)/4; excess alcohol yield multiplier নয়।

questions.question_bn: CaCO₃calcination 1tonnepurefeed; carbonateconversion 24%। emittedCO₂kg কত? MCaCO₃100,MCO₂44
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 24। Convertedmass 1000·(24)/100=10nkg CaCO₃। CO₂mass fraction 44/100⇒4.4nkg; combustionemissionexcluded।

questions.question_bn: Metalfeed 140 kg,smeltingyield 80%,purification recovery 90%। final metal কত kg?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 14। Sequential recovery multiply 0.8×0.9=0.72।10nkgfeed→7.2nkg; percentageyieldsadd নয়।

questions.question_bn: Impure CaCO₃sample excessHCl 16mmol reacts। leftoveracid needs NaOH 4mmol। CaCO₃ amount কত mmol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। HClconsumed=4×(4)−(4)=3nmmol। CaCO₃+2HCl uses 2acidpercarbonate; CaCO₃=1.5nmmol।

questions.question_bn: C12H22O molecular formula। degree of unsaturation কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। IHD=(2C+2−H)/2; oxygen বাদ। [2((9)+3)+2−(2×(9)+4)]/2=2। rings ওπbond মিলিয়ে 2।

questions.question_bn: Buffer HA/A⁻, p Ka=4। [A⁻]/[HA]=6। pH কোনটি?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 6। Henderson–Hasselbalch pH=p Ka+log(base/acid)=4+logn; ratio উল্টো নিলে sign বদলায়।

questions.question_bn: At fixedT Henry c=kP, dissolved gas concentration c₀ atP₀। P=8P₀ হলে concentration কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 8। Stated Henry form c=kP linear। sameT,k-এ pressure factor (8) gives concentration factor (8); alternative H conventions আলাদা হতে পারে।

questions.question_bn: κ=14×10⁻³S/cm,C=0.10 mol/L। Λm কত S·cm²/mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 14। Λm=1000κ/C withcM,κS/cm。1000·(14)10⁻³/0.10=10×(14); L→cm³factor 1000。

questions.question_bn: Weak monoprotic HA concentration 0.10M, Ka=9×10⁻⁸। x≪C। [H⁺] approx কত M?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 3। Ka≈x²/C⇒x=√(KaC)=√((3)²×10⁻⁹)=(3)×10⁻⁴⋅⁵। stated approximation check x/C ছোট থাকতে হবে।

questions.question_bn: 5molnon-electrolyte 500gwater-এ dissolve। molality কত mol/kg?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। Molality=moles/solventmasskg=(5)/0.5=2×(5)। solution volume বা solution mass denominator নয়।

questions.question_bn: 29 mol triglyceride complete NaOH saponification-এ NaOH কত mol লাগে?

questions.question_bn: Gas collected over water total pressure 24k Pa, water vapour 2k Pa। dry gas partial pressure কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। Dalton total P=Pdry+Pwater। dry pressure=Ptotal−Pvapour=(4)+18k Pa; vapour pressure বাদ দিতে হয়।

questions.question_bn: Equal volumes AgNO₃ ও Na Cl, each 22×10⁻⁴M। Ag Cl Ksp1×10⁻⁸। initial ionic product কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 22। Mixing doubles total volume, each ion concentration (22)×10⁻⁴/2। Qsp=((22)²/4)×10⁻⁸; তারপর Ksp তুলনা করে precipitation।

questions.question_bn: Bleach sample 3 mol OCl⁻ acidic iodometry-তে I₂ কত mol মুক্ত করে? OCl⁻+2I⁻+2H⁺→I₂+Cl⁻+H₂O
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 3। Balanced reaction অনুযায়ী OCl⁻:I₂=1:1। iodide coefficient 2 হলেও iodine molecules (3) mol; redox electron balance 2।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Ideal gas P2atm,V=147.60000000000002L,T300 K,R0.082। amount কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 12। (12)=PV/(RT)=2·12.3×(12)/(0.082·300)=24.6×(12)/24.6=(12) mol; no extra Avogadro multiplication।

questions.question_bn: Acyclic hydrocarbon C19H38 with oneC=C, no ring। sigma-bond count কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 19। C–C skeleton tree has (19)−1sigma, including double-bond oneσ। C–H bonds 2×(19)σ। total 3×(19)−1; πbond excluded।

questions.question_bn: M²⁺+2e⁻→M(s),25°C। ion concentration 10⁻12M। E−E° কত V?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 12। Q=1/[M²⁺]=10ⁿ, solidsactivity 1। Nernstshift−0.0592×(12)/2=−0.0296nV; dilution reduction potential কমায়।

questions.question_bn: l=20 subshell-এ magnetic quantum number mₗ কতটি value নিতে পারে?

questions.question_bn: Food wet mass 230g,dry mass 184g। wet-basis moisture content কত %?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 23। Wet-basis moisture=(wet−dry)/wet×100=2×(23)/(10×(23))×100=20%; dry-basis হলে 25%।

questions.question_bn: Water[Ca²⁺]=7mmol/L, no Mg। CaCO₃ equivalent hardness কত mg/L? MCaCO₃100g/mol

questions.question_bn: Ag Cl Ksp=1×10⁻¹⁰। Na Cl solution [Cl⁻]=30×10⁻²M, Ag Cl saturated; s≪[Cl⁻]। [Ag⁺] কত M?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 30। Ksp=[Ag⁺][Cl⁻]। common-ion approximation s=10⁻¹⁰/((30)×10⁻²)=(1/(30))×10⁻⁸M।

questions.question_bn: H-like ion Z=24, transition 3→2। photon energy/13.6eV কত?

questions.question_bn: Two equal bond dipoles μ=28D make 120°। net dipole কত D?

questions.question_bn: 0.1M HCl 40 mL ও 0.1M NaOH 20 mL mix; additive volume। final[H⁺] কত M?

questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 10। H₂limiting:reactionextent=(2×(10))/3,availableN₂(10) larger। NH₃=2extent=4×(10)/3 mol; balanced coefficients essential।
